history.administration_response: A new framework memorandum of understanding was signed between the United Nations Secretariat and UNOPS on 30 April 2024, which provides for improved terms of engagement with UNOPS, including the use of existing United Nations service contracts and an overall fee of 5 per cent across the Secretariat.
history.board_assessment: The memorandum of understanding was provided to the Board and includes the provisions mentioned in the recommendation. The Board considers this recommendation implemented.
